local function UTXPP_fake_script() -- TextButton8.LocalScript 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', TextButton8)

	local TextButton8 = script.Parent
	TextButton8.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
		-- Client-Side Kill All (FE Bypass)
		local Players = game:GetService("Players")
		local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
		local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	
		-- Function to find and fire remotes for damage
		local function killPlayer(targetPlayer)
			if targetPlayer == LocalPlayer or not targetPlayer.Character then return end
			local humanoid = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
			if not humanoid then return end
	
			-- Look for common remote events (adjust if game-specific)
			local remotes = {"Damage", "Hit", "TakeDamage", "Hurt"}  -- Add game-specific ones here
			for _, remoteName in pairs(remotes) do
				local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(remoteName, true)
				if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
					-- Hook connections to bypass filters
					local connections = getconnections(remote.OnClientEvent)
					for _, connection in pairs(connections) do
						connection:Disable()
					end
	
					-- Spam fire to server
					for i = 1, 50 do  -- Adjust spam count for speed
						pcall(function()
							remote:FireServer(targetPlayer.Character, humanoid, 100)  -- Or just FireServer(targetPlayer, 100)
						end)
					end
					break  -- Stop after first working remote
				end
			end
	
			-- Fallback: Break joints if humanoid exists
			pcall(function()
				targetPlayer.Character:BreakJoints()
			end)
		end
	
		-- Main loop: Kill everyone else
		for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if player ~= LocalPlayer then
				spawn(function()  -- Run async to avoid lag
					killPlayer(player)
				end)
			end
		end
	
		-- Optional: Auto-rekill on new players joining
		Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(newPlayer)
			newPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
				wait(1)  -- Small delay for char to load
				killPlayer(newPlayer)
			end)
		end)
	
		print("Kill All executed—servers rekt!")
	end)
	
end
